_comment: DATA_MODEL.md sidebar_sections 「セクションの中の並び順」 (2026-10-06; Japanese collation and the three sorts 2026-10-07): the order of conversations inside a sidebar / home section, the same on every client. names: the name order. Level 1 compares the name after NFKD with the combining marks dropped (U+0300-U+036F and the kana voicing marks U+3099 / U+309A), element by element: class 0 = symbols, spaces and the rest below U+3040 (by code point; also ゛゜ゝゞ・ーヽヾ and U+FF00-U+FFEF), class 1 = a run of ASCII digits compared as a number (leading zeros dropped, then the shorter run first, then digit by digit), class 2 = Latin letters A-Z case folded, class 3 = kana (katakana folded to hiragana, small kana to the large ones; hiragana code point order is gojūon), class 4 = kanji (the JIS X 0208 kanji in JIS order from apps/shared/gen_jis_kanji.py: level 1 by on-reading, level 2 by radical; other ideographs after them by code point), class 5 = everything else (Hangul, emoji…) by code point; a shorter name that is a prefix first. Level 2 (equal level 1): the name after NFKC with A-Z lower-cased and katakana folded to hiragana, by UTF-16 code unit (so plain kana before voiced, 02 before 2). Level 3: the raw name by UTF-16 code unit (upper case before lower case, hiragana before katakana). No platform collator: ICU ja (Intl.Collator / Foundation) gives the same level-1 order on these names but its ties differ, and Android's unit tests run on the JVM's java.text.Collator, which differs (no numbers, half-width kana last). sections: `sort` (default "name") is a section's 並べ替え: name = channels (public / private) by name (equal names by id), then DMs and group DMs by their display title (the client's own title, `title` here; equal titles by id); recent = every conversation newest first (last_message_at, else created_at, compared as the server's text; equal times by id ascending); manual = the ids of `manual_order` first in that order (ids not in the section are skipped), the rest after them in name order. The default 「ダイレクトメッセージ」 puts my own DM first in name and recent; Times and 「チャンネルを探す」 are always by name. Muting does not move a row; archived channels are not listed at all. Hand-written (expected orders checked with a reference script); desktop (tests/sidebarOrder.test.ts), iOS (SidebarOrderTests) and Android (SidebarOrderTest) read this file.

names.name: the report: 院 (イン) before 修 (シュウ) after the same number
level-2 kanji after level 1, other ideographs last
equal numbers: the zero-padded one first
ASCII case is ignored, then upper case first
full-width letters as half-width, accents ignored
katakana among hiragana, half-width kana too
voiced kana after the plain one, small kana as large
voiced kana: level 1 ignores the marks

sections.name: name: channels by name, then DMs by title
recent: without messages by when it was made, equal times by id
manual: the saved order, unknown ids skipped, the rest after by name
name: the same name by id
name: recent activity does not move a channel
